using System.Collections.Generic;
using Everlong.Globalization;

namespace MyApp.Lang;

/// <summary>
/// This class was generated by <c>dotnet elg gen</c>.
/// <para>Usage:</para>
/// <list type="bullet">
/// <item><description>Update strings in the JSON files under locale subdirectories.</description></item>
/// <item><description>Add a locale by creating a new subdirectory (for example <c>zh-CN\</c>) with matching JSON files.</description></item>
/// <item><description>Regenerate by running <c>dotnet elg gen</c> from the project directory.</description></item>
/// <item><description>Configuration file: <c>Properties\i18n\i18n.json</c>.</description></item>
/// <item><description>Do not edit generated files manually; they are overwritten on next generation.</description></item>
/// </list>
/// </summary>
public static partial class Lang
{
  public static readonly LangProvider Provider = new(Locales.En);

  public static ILangManifest Manifest { get; } = new LangManifestImpl();

  public static DefaultStrings Default { get; } = new DefaultStrings(Provider);

  public static class Locales
  {
    public static readonly IStringProvider En = new DictionaryStringProvider(new Dictionary<string, string>
    {
      ["RangeHintFormat"] = "Range: {0} ~ {1}",
    });
  }

  private sealed class LangManifestImpl : ILangManifest
  {
    public LangProvider Provider => Lang.Provider;
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IStringProvider> SupportedLocales { get; } =
      new Dictionary<string, IStringProvider>
      {
        ["en"] = Locales.En,
      };
  }
}

public sealed class DefaultStrings : StringSectionBase
{
  internal DefaultStrings(LangProvider provider) : base(provider, "")
  {
  }

  public string RangeHint => GetString("RangeHintFormat", "Range: {0} ~ {1}");
  public string FormatRangeHint(object? arg0, object? arg1) => IcuMessageFormatter.Format(RangeHint, new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["arg0"] = arg0, ["arg1"] = arg1 });
}
